properties.name: tenantkit.web.enabled
properties.description: Master switch of the web module; false exits the module's auto-configuration entirely while user beans stay untouched.

properties.name: tenantkit.resolution.strategies
properties.description: Ordered resolution chain (jwt-claim | header | subdomain | fixed); list order is priority order, the first non-empty result wins. Empty means the module resolves nothing.

properties.name: tenantkit.resolution.fixed
properties.description: Fixed tenant value; required when strategies contains 'fixed'.

properties.name: tenantkit.resolution.tenant-id-pattern
properties.description: TenantId validation regex. Relaxing the default charset re-opens an injection surface; read the provisioning chapter before widening it.

properties.name: tenantkit.resolution.jwt-claim
properties.description: Claim name read from the verified JWT (JwtAuthenticationToken only).

properties.name: tenantkit.resolution.trust-proxy
properties.description: Whether a directly connected client may set the tenant header. Declaring 'header' with this false fails startup; true without the header strategy logs a warning.

properties.name: tenantkit.resolution.subdomain.base-domains
properties.description: Base domains for the 'subdomain' strategy, e.g. saas.example.com. Ports are rejected at startup as ambiguous; matching happens on the port-stripped hostname.

properties.name: tenantkit.resolution.ignore-paths
properties.description: Ant patterns short-circuited at filter level: no resolution, no failure. Takes precedence over @TenantPublic.

properties.name: tenantkit.resolution.unknown-tenant-status
properties.description: HTTP status for TK-1002 (unknown tenant). Consider 400 when clients cannot enumerate tenants safely.

properties.name: tenantkit.tenants
properties.description: Static tenant catalog. Omit it to plug a DB-backed TenantCatalog bean instead; the directory table itself must stay exempt from any row-level filter.

values.description: Verified JWT claim from Spring Security authentication.
Sub-domain of a configured base domain.
